svg.desc: Cleopatra Mall LOCATION 6th of October, Egypt CLIENT El Dorado Ceramics & Sanitary Ware Company STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 400 Million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Eldorado Ceramic and Sanitary Ware International commissioned a landmark commercial center in 6th October City, Egypt, spanning 384,000 m2. Designed to deliver a high-end shopping experience, the project features a dynamic mix of retail outlets, cinemas, hotels, and restaurants. The scope of work included architecture, landscape, environmental design, structural and civil engineering, MEP, urban design and planning, as well as project management and site supervision.
